description.text: Business Administration program comes under the Business Administration department of college of economics and management. Relying on the two disciplines of "management" and "economics", we foster and provide the senior practical management talents for the national defender agencies, local enterprises, financial organizations who will effectively contribute to production and operation, human resources and financial management. The college of economics and management possesses a center laboratory with usable area of 1033m2, including ERP Lab, E-commerce and Logistics Lab, Financial Lab, simulation Lab for Enterprise business decision, Accounting simulation Lab, and experimental innovation Room , which provide an open platform for the practicing teaching of our related courses. For the effective implementation of talent training mode of combination of the theoretical and practical teaching, we provide following core courses: Management, Economics, Management Information Systems, Statistics, Accounting, Financial Management, Marketing, Economic law, Human Resource Management, Enterprises strategic Management. In fostering process we highlight the training of research innovation and professional skills, emphasizing the training of practical capacity.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Nanchang Hangkong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Passport ;2.Application form ;3.High school transcripts ;4.High school graduation certificate;5.Self-introduction video ( 3-5 minutes ):Self-introduction (age, family background, education background, personality, hobbies)Why do you choose to study this major ?Why do you choose to study in Nanchang Hangkong University ?How do you spend your four years in China ?Documents needed for applying for JW202 form:6.two inch photo (photo of passport);7.physical examination form;8.non-criminal record;9.Proof of bank deposit.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health.2. Education background and age limit:Applicants for undergraduate program must have senior high school diploma with good academic performance and be under the age of 22.3.Obey the relevant laws of the PRC and meet the admission requirements of the host universities.4. Applicants must have a good academic record and merits.
